subject: Re: Kickoff: ACT clarification-turn service — April status
body:
Hi both,

Status ahead of Friday:

- Pipeline milestone hit. convert_pacific.py runs cleanly on both train.json and validation.json, emitting train.jsonl / validation.jsonl, and the 20-entry sampled smoke run finishes in under an hour in the container.
- Full PACIFIC fine-tune is mid-flight. Early eval: the ACT model asks a clarifying question on 41% of ambiguous turns vs 17% for the SFT baseline, at equal answer quality on unambiguous turns.

Risk: the distillation recipe is behind. My first student run lost 6.2pp on the clarification-action accuracy, which is too much for the alpha. I think the contrastive pairs need to be re-generated from the student's own rollouts, thats another ~2 weeks of my time. Would push the May 15 alpha to the very end of the window.

Maren
